description: Solve a staff rostering problem to optimality with a MILP solver and return who works which shift each day, coverage, unfilled posts, hours per person and warnings. Solves take 5-60 s. Pass either `example` (to solve a built-in example as-is) or the roster input fields. If the result has status 'running', call get_shift_roster_result with its job_id. If it has status 'too_large', shorten the horizon or reduce people/shift types and retry. Roster input. Minimal example: {"days": ["2026-10-05", "2026-10-06"], "shifts": [{"shift": "Day", "start": "07:00", "end": "19:00"}, {"shift": "Night", "start": "19:00", "end": "07:00", "night": "yes"}], "demands": [{"name": "RN", "penalty": 500}], "people": [{"name": "Ana", "cost": 40, "max_hw": 48}, ...], "grids": {"RN": {"2026-10-05|Day": 2, "2026-10-05|Night": 1}}, "parameters": {"MinRestHours": 11}}. Call get_shift_example for complete, realistic inputs.

days.description: Day labels in order: ISO dates ('2026-10-05') or weekday names ('Mon'). Dates or weekdays enable weekend rules.

demands.description: Posts to fill (roles). Headcount per day/shift goes in grids.

concurrent.description: true = the same person may cover this and another demand at once.

penalty.description: Cost of leaving ONE post unfilled for one shift. Must be well above one person's pay for a shift or the solver will prefer gaps. Omitted = 10 x the highest hourly cost x the longest shift.

example.description: Solve this built-in example instead of passing the fields below.

grids.description: Optional per-day/shift cells, keyed by a demand name or a person name, each an object keyed 'DAY|SHIFT'. Demand grid value = headcount required (demand with no grid = 1 on every shift). Person grid value: 'a' or 1 = available, 'f' = must work, 0 or missing = UNAVAILABLE (person with no grid = available everywhere).

parameters.description: Optional rules. MinRestHours (11), MaxConsecutiveDays (6), MaxConsecutiveNights (4), ForbidDayAfterNight ('yes'), NightStartsAfter ('18:00'), MinBlockDays (1), WeekendFairnessPenalty (0), EquityPenalty (0) = even out total hours, NightEquityPenalty (0) = even out total nights (try 20), NightDifferential (1.0), WeekendDifferential (1.0), TimeLimitSeconds (max 60 here), GapPercent (2).

max_dw.description: Max days worked over the WHOLE roster.

max_hw.description: Max hours over the WHOLE roster (hard). Not per week: for a 28-day roster at 40h/week use 160.

min_dw.description: Min days worked over the WHOLE roster.

min_hw.description: Min hours over the WHOLE roster (soft).

shifts.description: Shift types. A shift may cross midnight (end < start).

night.description: 'yes' = counts as a night shift. Omitted = decided from NightStartsAfter.

skills.description: Who can cover which demand. Omitted = everyone can cover every demand.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the solve inside this call (default 25).

name: build_shift_roster
title: Build an optimized shift roster
